capabilities: Add parents, children and related tags to tags in a sidebar tab
Collapse and expand tag branches inside the core Graph view
Switch between force, mind map and vertical or horizontal tree layouts
Explore the hierarchy in a 3D view and an object-card explorer
Check the dictionary for unregistered, unused and redundant tags
extras: Desktop only; hooks into undocumented Graph view internals that a future Obsidian update may break. The 3D view and ontology explorer are beta and can be turned off. The bundle is about 1.6 MB and makes no network requests. A standalone npm CLI and library expose the same dictionary rules.
intentEvidence: An extension of the core graph.
motivation: The author wanted concepts to have several parents and related tags and to explore those relationships separately, while keeping document locations and source text intact.
problem: Nested tags and folders force a concept into a single path, which hides its other relationships.

relations.evidence: Pair it with TOW to manage tags and dictionaries with AI agents
feeding custom data to the core graph renderer was inspired by Nested tags graph

requires.name: Graph view (core), with Filters → Tags on

summary: Sidebar editor that gives tags parents, children and related tags, and shows the hierarchy in the core Graph view, mind maps, trees and a 3D view.
